ammonia.reason: NH3 from amino-acid deamination by Brevibacterium/lactobacilli raises smear surface to pH 7.5

animal_barnyard.reason: p-cresol/indole plus Brevibacterium sulfur from Trp/Tyr catabolism in smear

bitter.reason: hydrophobic peptides from rennet/plasmin proteolysis, partly debittered by smear peptidases

blue_moldy.reason: no Penicillium roqueforti inoculation, no C7/C9 methyl-ketone blue pathway

browning.reason: Maillard between residual lactose/galactose and lysine on heating

buttery.reason: diacetyl/acetoin from citrate metabolism by mesophilic Lactococcus starters

cheesy_sweaty.reason: butanoic acid lipolysis plus 3-methylbutanoic acid from Leu catabolism, cited as main cheesy notes

creaminess.reason: 25.98% fat ~45% FDM with 42.86% moisture and 2-3 mo proteolysis gives smooth supple paste

crumbliness.reason: elastic washed-rind protein matrix, not dry-grana fracture

firmness.reason: semi-hard smear loaf at ~43% moisture, sliceable supple body with small eyes

floral_honey.reason: low phenylacetaldehyde/2-phenylethanol from Phe transamination by lactobacilli

fruity.reason: low ethyl butanoate/hexanoate from lipase free acids + ethanol esterification

goaty.reason: cow milk lacks 4-methyloctanoic/4-ethyloctanoic goaty branched acids

malty_nutty.reason: Strecker 2-/3-methylbutanal from Ile/Leu plus methional boiled-potato note

melt.reason: rennet gel demineralized then smear-deacidified flows well, not acid heat-set

mushroom_earthy.reason: low 1-octen-3-ol/1-octen-3-one from linoleic acid oxidation by Geotrichum/microflora

oil_off.reason: moderate 26% fat releases some free oil on heating, not high-fat oiling

smoky.reason: typical make unsmoked, no guaiacol/phenol deposition

sour_vinegar.reason: lactic/acetic from mesophilic starter, largely consumed/deacidified by smear yeasts

stretch.reason: no pasta-filata hot-water kneading, rennet curd only short elasticity

sulfur_cooked.reason: MeSH 23-307 ppb, DMS, DMDS, DMTS 50-500x threshold from Met demethiolation by Brevibacterium

sweet.reason: trace residual lactose/galactose and diacetyl sweet impression, low

umami.reason: free glutamate and savory DMTS/methional from 1-3 mo proteolysis
